column1: # Blue Book P-25.2.1 Table 2.8: retained names of heterocyclic parent ring components, transcribed from
# https://iupac.qmul.ac.uk/BlueBook/P2.html#250201 . table_group is the table's numbered group (descending seniority
# between groups as printed; not a total order, see P-25.3.2.4 and P-25.8.1). pin_name is the PIN with the indicated
# hydrogen the table states. fusion_prefix is the preferred prefix (P-25.3.2.2.2: final e -> o, or append o;
# heteroatom locants in square brackets, P-25.3.1.3). chromene-type names are not PINs (their PINs are the
# benzopyran rows; P-25.3.2.4(a) gives [1]benzopyrano[2,3-c]pyrrole as the PIN beside chromeno[2,3-c]pyrrole).
